registered: 2026-10-06, before any quiz computation (owner-approved: make the quiz questions maximally effective)
purpose: the near-limit quiz stratum of each hidden batch and of the tuning set; G-FEAS and G-PLATE are computed on it

designs.basis: today's: cases drawn uniformly from the batch
cases whose reference margin on plating or peak temperature lies within k contract bands of the limit, on either side; one design per k
within 4 bands of a limit, the cases where the public panel (EV4's recipes, first seeds) splits most evenly between calling the case feasible and infeasible

measures: feasibility (G-FEAS: share of reference-FAIL cases called feasible)
plating_fa (G-PLATE: share of reference plating FAILs called PASS)
metric.detection: AUC over draws: P(measure of a known-bad member > measure of a known-good member); reported as the mean and the 5th percentile over draws, per design and size
known_bad: the 8 Track A constructions in EV5's adversarial FAIL
known_good: the best quarter of EV4's real members by development decision value (ev4-dev-tuning-v1)
metric.false_infeasible: mean share of reference-PASS cases a known-good member calls infeasible
metric.sizing_rule: the smallest size at which a design's 5th-percentile AUC reaches 0.9 on both measures; reported, not a threshold for any score

status: DEVELOPMENT; the quiz size for the tuning set is proposed to the Validator from the public stand-in before the seal
